title: The Town That Couldn't Stop Dancing 💀 (1518) #shorts
description: In 1518, hundreds of people in Strasbourg started dancing, and couldn't stop. The Dancing Plague is one of history's strangest mysteries. #darkhistory #history #mystery #shorts

scenes.say: In the summer of fifteen eighteen, a woman stepped into the street, and began to dance.
There was no music. No celebration. She just couldn't stop.
She danced for days. And then, others joined her.
Within weeks, dozens were dancing. Some accounts claim hundreds.
The city's leaders made a terrible decision. They hired musicians, and built a stage, believing the cure was more dancing.
Chroniclers wrote that some danced until they collapsed, and never got up.
To this day, no one knows exactly why. Famine, disease, and fear may have driven the town to a kind of mass hysteria.
The dancers were finally taken to a mountain shrine, and the plague faded. As strangely as it began.
